reviewDescription: I got this for a trip where I was going to have a roommate because I always listen to audiobooks to fall asleep, but I didn't want to disturb them. I can never get earbuds to stay in my ear and didn't want something big and bulky. This headband worked perfectly and felt great. It's not too tight and the material is soft. The speakers at the ears were flat and felt fine when I laid on my side. My roommate couldn't hear anything, and I could also pull it down over my eyes like an eye mask. Really handy and stayed charged for days.
reviewedIn: Reviewed in the United States on March 8, 2026
